title: BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a Fifth Amendment to Contract No. C-141031 between the Office of Finance and Electronic Output Solutions,…
text:
[Council File 16-0678-S1]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to a Fifth Amendment to Contract No. C-141031 between the Office of Finance and Electronic Output Solutions, Inc. for variable imaging and electronic billing communications services.
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. APPROVE and AUTHORIZE the Director, Office of Finance, or designee, to execute the proposed Fifth Amendment to Contract No. C-141031 between the Office of Finance and Electronic Output Solutions, Inc. for variable imaging, mailing, and electronic billing communications services, to extend the contract term by five years from June 1, 2027 through May 31, 2032, for a cumulative term of ten years, with no contract ceiling.
2. INSTRUCT the Office of Finance to correct the Term Section of the Fifth Amendment to Contract No. C-141031 to a contract end date of May 31, 2032.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Administrative Officer (CAO) reports that funding in the amount of $300,000 is available in the Office of Finance's Fiscal Year 2026-27 Adopted Budget within the Contractual Services Account. Funding in the subsequent years will be subject to approval by the Mayor and Council through the annual budget process. There is no additional impact to the General Fund. Financial policies The CAO reports that the recommendations stated in the report are in compliance statement with the City’s Financial Policies in that current operations will be funded by current revenues.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
TIME LIMIT FILE - DECEMBER 15, 2026 (LAST DAY FOR COUNCIL ACTION - DECEMBER 15, 2026)
summary: Council is approving a five-year extension, through May 31, 2032, of the Office of Finance's contract with Electronic Output Solutions for bill printing, mailing and electronic billing, with no dollar ceiling.
